description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing two counters from it, returning Plague Belcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Plague Belcher enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Plague Belcher, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Reaping Willow
uses.cardState: with two or more counters on it
